chunks: Ahmad ibn Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us from my grandfather, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Abu Abdillah al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon them both), who said:
Whoever supplicates for forty believers before supplicating for himself, his supplication will be answered.

key_terms.استجيب: To be answered — divine acceptance of supplication
key_terms.دعاء: Supplication (du'a) — a personal prayer or invocation to God

ai.seo_question: What is the etiquette of supplication in Islam according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) teaches the etiquette of supplication, advising that one who prays for forty fellow believers before praying for himself will have his prayer accepted. This hadith, narrated in a teaching assembly in 368 AH, underscores the communal spirit of Islamic prayer and the virtue of selflessness in supplication.

en.bilal-muhammad: Ahmad b. `Ali b. Ibrahim b. Hashim (ra) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us from my grandfather from Muhammad b. Abi `Umayr from Hisham b. Salim from Abi `Abdillah al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad (as). He said:
Whoever supplicates for forty believers before he supplicates for himself, his supplication will be granted for him.
